name: youtube-ai-summary
description: Chrome extension that sends a YouTube video's transcript to an AI chat with a summary prompt.

scripts.check: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json'))" && node --check extension/shared.js && node --check extension/youtube.js && node --check extension/ai.js && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/popup.js
